messages:
alex r.: Morning triage — quick snapshot. 14 open tickets, inbox quieter than yesterday. Top two: embeddings timeouts (5) and webhook retry loop (3). I pushed a macro tweak for embeddings errors. @tanya can you take the two oldest embedding threads?

tanya: On it. Which macro did you change?

alex r.: Macro name = EMB_TIMEOUT_RETRY. Added a short checklist to ask for exact model, sequence length, and a diagnostic command to reduce back-and-forth. Snippet:
```
Macro: EMB_TIMEOUT_RETRY
Action: ask for model, seq_len, attach logs, run: `curl -X POST https://diag.redwood.internal/v1/collect`
```
Also flagged one customer as P1 for webhook retries.

maya: :eyes: I'll patch the webhook retry rule on staging and run the synthetic test. ETA ~20m.

ron: Heads-up — ticket #10234 asked for logs after macro applied; I left the macro command in the thread. If they paste logs we can triage faster.

oncall-bot: Deploy started: support/macro-update EMB_TIMEOUT_RETRY v2 -> staging (build 2026-03-17_09:12).

tanya: Applied the updated macro to 3 threads, requested model + token counts. Also added a micro-template for embedding timeouts to cut down replies.

alex r.: Nice. Quick backlog policy: if we see >2 repeats of the same failure after the patch, escalate to @eng-sre and we'll open a follow-up.

maya: Patch looks good on staging (synthetic passed). Planning prod roll in ~10m unless anyone objects.

ron: No objections — I'll monitor prod alerts for the next hour.

tanya: Small wording tweak: remind customers to include the `inputs` field in logs. Saves a diagnostic step.

alex r.: Thanks all. Volume trend: down ~12% vs yesterday morning. I'll do a short postmortem if webhook errors spike again. Update this thread when prod roll completes. :white_check_mark:
